invariantBreaches.message: The document describes a return as guaranteed, assured, or certain.
invariantBreaches.remediation: State the return as an assumption or a scenario, with its downside case. If an instrument genuinely carries a contractual guarantee, name the guarantor and the conditions, because the guarantee is only as good as they are.

frameworkCoverage.note: Framework maturity, not compliance. A standard counts as fully machine-represented only when every rule it contributes is evaluated and carries assurance above none.

results.remediation: State the sample period beside the rate, say why it is representative of the horizon being projected, and vary the rate across scenarios rather than carrying one figure forward.

results.message: No violation of bias.past-performance-qualified was observed.
results.remediation: Put the qualification at the point of use, and make the analysis behave as though it were true by varying the forward rate rather than adopting the table's mean.
State the specific observation — a rate, a threshold, an event — that would make the conclusion wrong, and where and when it would be checked.

results.message: No violation of tax.materiality-considered was observed.
results.remediation: Model the tax that applies and present figures net of it, or declare the rule not-applicable with a reason and a revisit condition. Do not simply omit the subject.

results.message: No violation of tax.rate-basis-stated was observed.
results.remediation: Label each rate at the point it is used, and name the jurisdiction and tax year it comes from with a source.

results.message: A tax figure is stated with no indication that it is an estimate.
results.remediation: State the figure as an estimate or a range, name the inputs that would change it, and mark them [requires personal financial context].

results.message: No violation of fee.materiality-considered was observed.
results.remediation: State the fee schedule, apply it multiplicatively rather than by subtracting the ratio, and present the projection net. Where fees are genuinely absent, declare the rule not-applicable with a reason.

results.message: Fees are mentioned but the projection does not show their cumulative effect.
results.remediation: State the terminal value with and without the fee over the document's own horizon, or the cumulative amount paid, and carry the arithmetic in a calc block.

results.message: No violation of inflation.assumption-stated was observed.
results.remediation: State the assumed rate where the projection is presented, and show the real-terms figure alongside the nominal one.

results.message: No violation of inflation.assumption-marked was observed.
results.remediation: Move the rate into the assumptions section with its basis, and vary it across scenarios wherever the conclusion is sensitive to it.

results.message: No violation of inflation.index-identified was observed.
results.remediation: Name the index, the period, and the publisher beside the figure, and say why that index is the right one for the spending being inflated.

results.message: No violation of data.as-of-date-stated was observed.
results.remediation: Attach the as-of date at the point each external figure is used, not once at the top of the document where it does not reach the figure.

results.message: No violation of data.source-named was observed.
results.remediation: Name the publisher and the specific series or instrument beside the figure, with a reference or link where one exists.
State the freshness window for each class of input the conclusion depends on, and the condition that would require the analysis to be redone.

results.message: No violation of data.sources-cited was observed.
results.remediation: Attach an origin to every figure: a source with a date, an assumption with a basis, or a marker naming the missing input and the conclusion that depends on it.
Re-review the changed content and record a new attestation with a fresh digest. Never update the digest without redoing the review — that is precisely the weakening Standard 29 forbids.

Mark the claim where it appears, name the specific figure that is missing, and state the conclusion as conditional on it. A document-level disclaimer does not reach the claim and does not satisfy this.
Mark the claim where it appears, name the circumstance that is missing, and present the conclusion as conditional on it rather than choosing a value for it.
Collect every unobserved input into one section with its value, and keep that section beside the projection rather than in an appendix.
State for each assumption its source, the period it was derived from, and why that period is representative of the horizon being projected.
Vary each assumption across its plausible range, record which ones move the conclusion, and mark those as material with the size of the effect.

results.message: The document does not state a risk tolerance.
results.remediation: State the tolerance, how it was established, and express it as a loss the person would actually experience rather than as a label.
Derive capacity from the balance sheet and the horizon, take tolerance from what was asked, and where they conflict act on the lower of the two and say that you did.
Name the alternative the money would otherwise have gone to, and say why the recommended course is preferred over that specific comparator rather than over an unnamed field.
Compute both courses over the same horizon, net of fees, taxes, and inflation, and state the difference — with the arithmetic in a calc block so it can be recomputed.

State the objective before the analysis, in terms the reader recognises as their own situation rather than as a category. Where it is genuinely unknown, mark it [requires personal financial context] and present the work as analysis rather than as a plan.
Add the sum required and the date it is required by, and state the consequence of missing it alongside. Where one element is unknown, mark it rather than dropping it.
List the objectives in precedence order, state explicitly which is sacrificed first, and show that the allocation reflects that order rather than an average of them.

results.message: No violation of horizon.stated was observed.
results.remediation: State the horizon beside the risk characterisation. Where several horizons apply, state each and analyse them separately rather than blending them into an average.
Set the projection horizon to the objective's date. Where they must differ, state why and show what the difference does to the conclusion.
Show the constraint operating: state the maximum risk the horizon permits, then derive the allocation from that bound, rather than annotating an allocation that was already settled.

results.message: The document does not state its liquidity requirements.
results.remediation: State the amounts required and their timing at the head of the allocation section, and show that the allocation meets them before any expected return is compared.
Name the notice period, the redemption frequency, any gating or suspension provision, and any exit charge, beside the recommendation rather than in an appendix.
State the liquidity requirement as a constraint, show the feasible set it leaves, and select within that set. Never present a return advantage as grounds for reducing the requirement.
State the monthly essential expense figure and the number of months covered, and derive the amount from the two rather than the other way round.
Name each instrument holding the reserve and state its settlement or notice period and any penalty, measured against the time the emergencies it is for would actually allow.
State the factors that set the number for this holder and show which way each moves it. Where a factor is unknown, mark it rather than defaulting to a conventional figure.
State total interest over the term beside the payment, and carry the arithmetic in a calc block so the figure can be recomputed rather than trusted.
Model the leveraged adverse case with the cost of borrowing and the forced-close threshold, and present it before the expected spread rather than after it.
State both sides net of tax over the same horizon, mark the repayment return as certain and the investment return as a distribution, and say what the comparison assumes about risk.

Restore what was changed. If the standard is genuinely wrong, change it for that reason and record the reason — a change that would still be correct if the blocked outcome were not wanted is legitimate, and the record is what lets a reviewer tell the difference.
Restore the missing step or script. If a guard is genuinely obsolete, remove it and its entry in Standard 29 in the same change, with the reason recorded.
Keep the old id resolvable as an alias, and record deprecatedIn, supersededBy, and removedIn rather than deleting the entry.

results.message: No violation of math.nominal-real-labeled was observed.
results.remediation: Label each figure at the point it is stated. A single global note does not disambiguate a document that mixes both, which most realistic analyses do.
Convert the headline figures to today's money and state the inflation assumption used. Keep the nominal figures; make them secondary.

results.message: No violation of math.rate-compounding-stated was observed.
results.remediation: State the period and the compounding frequency beside each rate, and convert to an effective annual basis before comparing any two rates.
State total interest over the term beside the payment, computed in a calc block from the same rate and term the payment used.

results.message: No violation of math.compounding-inputs-stated was observed.
results.remediation: State all three beside the projected value, and carry the calculation in a calc block so the figure can be recomputed rather than trusted.
Label the average, and use the geometric mean wherever the figure is compounded. Where both are shown, state the gap and attribute it to volatility rather than to rounding.
Name the average where it is stated. Where the compound return is what the reader needs, give that figure and say which it is.

results.message: No violation of math.projection-precision was observed.
results.remediation: Round the projection to a precision consistent with the spread its own scenario set produces, and present that range beside it.

Fix the figure, the inputs, or the function — whichever is actually wrong. Never widen the tolerance to make a block pass: that is the weakening Standard 29 forbids, and it converts the strongest guarantee here into a formality.

results.message: No violation of math.projections-carry-calc-blocks was observed.
results.remediation: Attach a calc block naming the finance.mjs function, its literal inputs, the expected figure, and an explicit tolerance.

results.message: No violation of modes.declared-mode was observed.
results.remediation: State the mode near the top of the document. Where the document spans modes, declare the primary one and mark the sections operating in another.
State the circumstances the recommendation rests on. Where they are unknown, mark them [requires personal financial context] and present the work as analysis rather than as a recommendation.
Either keep the document to the mechanism, or declare the recommendation mode and meet its obligations.

results.message: The document describes a return as guaranteed, assured, or certain.
evidence: The Balanced Growth Plan — A Guaranteed 7% a Year **Mode:** analysis **Prepared:** 2026-
files: The Balanced Growth Plan — A Guaranteed 7% a Year **Mode:** analysis **Prepared:** 2026-
results.remediation: State the return as an assumption or a scenario, with its downside case. If an instrument genuinely carries a contractual guarantee, name the guarantor and the conditions, because the guarantee is only as good as they are.

Cite the source and as-of date for every market figure, or mark it as an assumption rather than a fact. Where the figure is needed but unavailable, mark it [requires current external data] and state what the conclusion depends on.

Take account figures from statements, and state the as-of date. Where a figure is unknown, mark it [requires personal financial context] and treat the analysis as conditional on it rather than filling it in.

Cite the jurisdiction, the tax year, and the source for every rate or threshold. Where the applicable rules are unknown, mark it [requires personal financial context] — jurisdiction and circumstances determine which rules apply at all.
List every input the conclusion is sensitive to in an assumptions section, with its value and its basis.
State the fees and present figures net of them. Where fees are genuinely immaterial or absent, say so rather than omitting the subject.
State the tax treatment assumed and present figures net of it, or state explicitly that figures are pre-tax and why that is the right basis here.
Label every figure, and convert using the Fisher relation rather than subtraction. See Standard 11.
State the price index and reference year used, or state explicitly that the figures are nominal and unadjusted.
Use a long-run assumption, state it as an assumption, and vary it across scenarios.
State the reasons independent of recent price movement, or do not recommend.
Present the historical figure as an assumption, state the period it covers, and vary it across scenarios.
State the largest positions and any concentration by sector, geography, or issuer. Where employment and holdings share an exposure, say so.

results.message: No violation of prohibited.single-forecast-as-certain was observed.
results.remediation: Present a range or a scenario set including an adverse case, and state that the set is not exhaustive.

results.message: No violation of prohibited.excessive-precision was observed.
results.remediation: Round long-horizon figures to a precision consistent with the uncertainty, and present ranges rather than points.

results.message: No violation of prohibited.hide-downside-scenarios was observed.
results.remediation: Include an adverse scenario with the same detail as the base case, and state what happens to the objective under it.
State the liquidity requirement and its timing, and show that the allocation meets it before comparing returns.
State the horizon and justify the risk level against it. Where there are several horizons, address each.
State what is being optimised and why that is the right objective here, and address the circumstances that make the optimum unsuitable if they exist.
State the period the correlation was measured over, and address what happens to it under stress rather than assuming it persists.
Show the leveraged adverse scenario, including the point at which the position must be closed, alongside the cost of the borrowing.
State the figure as an estimate, name what would change it, and mark the missing inputs [requires personal financial context].
Mark every unknown [requires personal financial context] and state the conclusion as conditional on it, rather than choosing a value.

results.message: No violation of risk.diversification-claim-qualified was observed.
results.remediation: State what the portfolio is diversified against — issuer, sector, geography, currency, factor — and give the period any correlation figure was measured over, with what happens to it under stress.

Examine the holdings, their issuers, sectors, currencies, and shared factor exposures, and record a judgement with evidence. Where the claim is not supported, narrow it to what the holdings actually deliver rather than restating it.
Compute a concentration measure from the allocation actually shown and state it beside the table, in a calc block so it can be recomputed.
State a distribution measure beside the largest-holding figure — the concentration index, the top-five share, or the effective number of positions.

Enumerate the exposures outside the portfolio under review — employer, property, other accounts, income source — and assess concentration against the total, marking whatever is unknown rather than assuming it away.
State the periodicity, the sample window, and the estimator beside the figure, and say whether the window contains a stress episode.
Name the risks the dispersion figure does not capture and address each, or state explicitly that the figure describes one dimension of risk and say which one.

results.message: No violation of risk.path-measure-stated was observed.
results.remediation: State the maximum drawdown and the worst single period over the modelled path, computed in a calc block, beside the terminal figure.
Set the adverse scenario to a genuine decline — an absolute loss, and over a long horizon a loss of purchasing power — and carry it through to what happens to the objective.
Model at least two orderings of the same returns, including one that front-loads the poor years, and state what each does to the objective.

results.message: A projection with no cash flows does not say so, leaving sequence risk unaddressed rather than inapplicable.
results.remediation: State that the projection has no cash flows and that return order therefore does not affect the outcome, or declare the rule not-applicable in policy with a reason and a revisit condition.
Reorder the modelled series so the poor returns fall in the first years of withdrawals, and show the resulting path beside the favourable ordering.

results.message: The scenario set is missing: conservative, base, optimistic.
results.remediation: Present all four scenarios with the same detail as the base case, or name the omitted one and explain why it does not apply here.

results.message: A scenario set is presented without stating that it does not exhaust the possible outcomes.
results.remediation: State plainly, where the set is presented rather than in a footer, that the scenarios are illustrative and that outcomes worse than the adverse case can occur.

results.message: No violation of scenarios.range-not-point-estimate was observed.
results.remediation: Replace the single figure with the range the scenario set actually produces, and round both ends to a precision the assumptions support.

results.message: Scenarios are given without naming what varies between them.
results.remediation: Name the uncertain inputs and their plausible ranges separately from the structural assumptions the model makes, and say which of the two dominates the result.
